name: laneHeaderTag
label: Vertical lanes header template
description: Template that creates vertical lane header.

name: cellHeaderTag
label: Cell-headers template
description: Template that creates cell header.

name: lanes
label: Vertical lanes header data
description: Array of vertical lanes on the board.

name: laneFooterTag
label: Vertical lanes footer template
description: Template that creates the lane footer.

name: laneDraggable
label: Allow dragging vertical lanes
description: Option to enable or disable the drag-and-drop feature for the vertical lanes.

name: laneDragPlaceholderTag
label: Drag source template
description: Template that displays the source from which a vertical lane is dragged

name: laneDropPlaceholderTag
label: Drop destination template
description: Template that displays the destination to which a vertical lane can be dropped

name: laneConfigOverride
label: Override vertical lanes configuration
description: Manages individual vertical lane configurations. This overrides the global vertical lane configurations.

name: swimlaneHeaderTag
label: Swimlanes header template
description: Template that creates a swimlane header.

name: showSwimlaneAsRow
label: Display swimlanes as row header
description: Option to show the swimlane header as part of the row instead of above

name: rowLaneHeaderTag
label: Lane header template for row column
description: Template that creates the row column lane header.

name: rowLaneConfig
label: Row lane configuration
description: Object that has configuration for the row lane header.

name: swimlaneHeaderCloneTag
label: Dragged-swimlane template
description: Template that creates a swimlane header when the vertical lane is dragged.

name: swimlanes
label: Swimlanes data
description: Data category that represents the array of swimlanes on the board.

name: swimlaneDraggable
label: Allow dragging swimlanes
description: Option to enable or disable the drag-and-drop feature for swimlanes.

name: swimlaneDragPlaceholderTag
label: Drag source template
description: Template that displays the source position of swimlane when it is dragged

name: swimlaneDropPlaceholderTag
label: Drop destination template
description: Template that displays the destination to which a swimlane can be dropped

name: swimlaneConfigOverride
label: Override swimlanes configuration
description: Manages the individual swimlane configurations. This overrides the global swimlane configurations.

name: cellHeaders
label: Cell-headers data
description: Array of cell headers where lanes and swimlanes meet

name: cardTag
label: Cards template
description: Template that creates a card.

name: cards
label: Cards data
description: Array of cards within the lanes.

name: cardDraggable
label: Allow dragging cards
description: Option to enable or disable the drag-and-drop feature for cards.

name: cardDragPlaceholderTag
label: Drag source template
description: Template that displays the source position of card from which it is dragged.

name: cardDropPlaceholderTag
label: Drop destination template
description: Template that displays the destination to which a card can be dropped.

name: cardDragOverlayTag
label: Dragged-card template
description: Template that gets displayed when the card is dragging

name: cardConfigOverride
label: Override cards configuration
description: Manages the individual card configurations. This overrides the global card configurations.

name: enableDependencyLines
label: Enable dependency lines
description: Option to display or hide dependency lines between cards

name: dependencyLines
label: Dependency lines configuration
description: Dependency lines are drawn between source and target cards

name: selectedCards
label: Selected cards
description: Array of cards to be displayed as selected, allowing multi-selection through the provided array.

name: cloneMode
label: Read-only mode
description: Option to enable or disable the "Read-only" view of the board.

name: wrapperDomEvents
label: Wrapper events
description: Manages events that occur in a wrapper container.

name: customScrollOptions
label: Scroll configuration
description: Customizes lane scrollbar.

name: loadTagsFromUxf
label: Load component from registry
description: Option to enable or disable the loading of components from UXF registry. For this, the component must be available in UXF registry.

name: styles
label: Advanced board styles
description: Applies custom styles to the component body.

name: daActionMapping
label: Declarative action map
description: Mapping object that maps inner and wrapper components, and board actions with declarative actions.

name: daClientActionContract
label: Declarative action-event mapping
description: Declarative action event mappings that may require data resource and component property configuration prior to usage.
